text:
lee: Quick follow-up on quant rollout boundaries. Need a minimal, operator-friendly plan for fp8/int8/4bit that avoids hidden quality drops.
anya: Agree. Minimal design: immutable artifact (sha256) + lightweight header that declares seq-length buckets and preferred format per bucket. Runtime picks bucket -> format.
tom: Add per-layer emergency guard: sample top-k activation percentile and flip that layer to higher precision if > threshold. Keep the check extremely cheap.
lee: For signals, capture: relative perplexity, token_mismatch_rate, P95 latency, and artifact_load_errors.
anya: Rollout steps: shadow (0%), sampled shadow (1%), canary (5%), canary (20%), ramp. Shadow traffic must be tagged quant.shadow.v1.
dev-ops-bot: NOTE: Tagging required for traceability. Metric names approved: quant.artifact_id, quant.bucket, quant.fallback_count, quant.perf_delta_pct.
tom: Thresholds proposal: abort if relative perplexity > 1.5% on sentinel eval OR token_mismatch_rate > 0.5% over 10k tokens.
lee: Ops playbook (short): reproduce with artifact, run shadow diff on golden prompts, toggle per-layer formats locally, if unresolved rollback artifact and open incident.
anya: Action items: lee draft header schema by Tue, tom add cheap runtime guard impl notes by Thu, dev-ops-bot will post rollout checklist.
lee: Keep pilot internal and single model. Low risk first. :thumbsup:
